text_block_list.text:
No! I can't snack like this, it'll just make
my bingo
wings heavier...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ryan, I was just, uh... giving my arms
a bit of
a pep talk. They're looking a
little flabby lately.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's good, though! Fat should be
treasured!
It'll eventually become the
energy for your
muscles!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Well, since we're here, do you wanna
work out
together and test it out?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ohh! I'd love to! Your workout routines
must be
really effective!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oh, but... um... please go easy on me!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Will do! Okay, first, let's see you do fifty
pull-ups
on that pull-up bar!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
R-Ryan... My arms, my arms! They're...
screaming
in pain!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Your muscles are crying in joy! Only five
left!
Savor every last one! You're on your
way to being
swole! ♪
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Мэдзиро Райан's workout
method, Nice
Nature succeeds in losing
some weight.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
